comment: Lookup table of allowed semester types (e.g. Winter, Summer), driving selectable values in the GUI rather than a hardcoded list.

columns.name: code
columns.comment: Stable, short machine-readable code for this semester type (e.g. WINTER), used directly as the primary key -- see CourseType for the reasoning behind lookup tables keyed on their natural code.

columns.name: display_name
columns.comment: Human-readable label shown in the GUI for this semester type.

columns.name: sort_order
columns.comment: Determines display order in GUI lists (e.g. a dropdown), independent of code or alphabetical order.

columns.name: is_active
columns.comment: Whether this semester type is currently selectable for new semesters. A deactivated type stays valid for any existing row still referencing it; it just stops being offered as a choice for new ones.
